title: solidago rugosa subsp. aspera
intro: Solidago rugosa subsp. aspera, commonly known as the rough-leaved goldenrod, is a subspecies of the Solidago rugosa plant, which is a perennial herb native to East Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Solidago rugosa subsp. aspera include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, making it useful in the management of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
